column1: # IRON STATIC audio slot table (A1-03). Source of truth for how each sound is played; read at runtime by AudioSlots.
# Swap a commissioned or newer sound = replace the file under assets/audio/ (or edit `file`) and keep the row; no code change.
# id: unique slot id. file: path relative to assets/audio/ (empty = reserved). bus: Master|Music|SFX|UI (default_bus_layout.tres).
# volume_db: per-slot trim. pitch_var: random pitch spread as a fraction (0.03 = +-3%). voice_cap: max simultaneous voices of the id.
# cooldown_ms: minimum time between two starts of the id. Music rows are the loop layers of the adaptive mix (rules: music_layers.csv).
